South Korea leads India 2-0 in Davis Cup tie

South Korea has taken a 2-0 lead against India in their Davis Cup tie held in Seoul. The Indian players reportedly adjusted well to the "low and slow" court conditions initially, but struggled as their matches progressed. The visitors lost both their singles matches in three sets, resulting in the deficit.
